```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(spatialreg)
library(spdep)
library(mapview)
```

```{r}
# importing data
swine <- read.csv("../data/clean/spatial_swine.csv")
us_states <- st_read("../data/raw/cb_2018_us_county_5m/cb_2018_us_county_5m.shp")
```

```{r}
lower_48 <- us_states |> 
  filter(STATEFP != "15"& STATEFP != "11" & STATEFP != "02" & STATEFP != "72"
         & STATEFP != "78" & STATEFP != "60" & STATEFP != "66" & STATEFP != "69"
         & GEOID != "53055" & GEOID != "25019")

swine_years <- swine |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(swine_2020,swine_2021,swine_2022,swine_2023,swine_2024, swine_2025), names_to = "year", values_to = "swine") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(str_remove(year, "swine_")),
         county_ID = as.character(county_ID)) |> 
  right_join(lower_48, join_by(county_ID == GEOID)) |> 
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geometry") |> 
  as(Class ="Spatial")
```

```{r}
# Fix this
nb <- poly2nb(swine_years, queen = TRUE)
listW <- nb2listw(nb, style = 'W')

nc_sar_lag <- lagsarlm(formula = log(swine+1) ~ year, data = swine_years, listw = listW, type="lag", method = "LU")
# LU added because it took too long
```

```{r}
swine$sar_lag <- exp(fitted(nc_sar_lag))

mapview(nb, zcol = "sar_lag")
```
